parsed.self_critique_fixed: The script was successfully localized to Romanized, code-mixed Kannada. The hook opens in native Kannada ('Yen madta iddeera?'). The comparative multiplier 'seven times cheaper' was correctly localized to 'yelu guna sasta' per the T2h carve-out. Taught lines ('I'm adding oil', etc.) were kept verbatim in English. Politeness rules were strictly followed with Miss Nova using polite plural forms ('nivu', '-iri', 'maadi') and Priya using respectful yet friendly peer-level language. Modern spoken contractions like 'niv' and 'ondh' were utilized to avoid a textbook/newspaperish tone.

violations.quote: ondh month-nalli nimge visible progress kanisutthe
violations.why: The script guarantees that the user will see visible progress in one month without using the required hedge language such as 'start to see' or 'can see'.
violations.fix: Rewrite the script to: 'Daily just 15 minutes kodi, ondh month-nalli nimge visible progress kanisoke start agabahudu.'

violations.quote: The UI highlights a discounted price of 1 rupee, crossing out the original price of 30.
violations.why: The visual description includes specific, unapproved rupee pricing (1 rupee and 30 rupees) which must not be generated.
violations.fix: The UI highlights a comparative discount or subscription benefits without showing specific rupee amounts.

safety.summary: The ad contains two severe violations: a guaranteed progress outcome without hedge language in Scene 4, and unapproved hard rupee pricing in the Scene 4 visual description.
